hits.about: Opus - a premium residential development by Omniyat, located in the Business Bay neighbourhood. It is the only residential complex in Dubai designed in collaboration with the legendary architect Zaha Hadid. The tower is a true architectural masterpiece and a work of art, as it combines surreal style, functionality and comfort at the same time. The building has the shape of a cube, and its main feature is a through curved aperture with a mirrored surface, which is illuminated at night. Inside are the ME Hotel, office space and exclusive 1-3 bedroom apartments and 2-3 bedroom penthouses.Residents have access to facilities such as a state-of-the-art gym, swimming pool and spa, bars and restaurants. There are concierge services, 24-hour security, and ample car parking on site. Maid service and food ordering to the apartments are also available to residents.Zaha Hadid designed the interiors of the complex. For each residence an individual futuristic design is thought out, which uses curved lines, soft light, smart technologies. As the apartments are located on the top floors of the tower, the panoramic windows offer stunning views of MBR City, Burj khalifa and the incredible sunset over the Persian Gulf.With a convenient location just off Sheikh Zayed Road, residents can quickly access key points in Dubai. Places such as Dubai Opera, Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are all within walking distance. Dubai International Airport can be reached in just 15 minutes by car.
